E1343

The retired audited-effect boolean is not accepted.

What

The retired audited-effect boolean is not accepted.

Why

Audited escapes share one policy ladder, so a boolean cannot express which gate is being authorized or which organization policy may refuse it.

Fix

use `--gate impure=allow`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1343: tests/ui/allow_impure_retired.stderr.

Error [E1343]: `--allow-impure` is retired
 Why: the old boolean changed which audited escapes were checked and is no longer accepted
 Fix: use `--gate impure=allow`
